fields.Institution: Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering and Technology – MBA
fields.Affiliation / University: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University
fields.Intake — Published:
180 MBA seats approved for 2025–26 in AICTE EOA; current 2026–27 EOA not located.
Published numeric intake: 180
fields.Fees — Published:
Official homepage FAQ explicitly states MBA ₹1.60 lakh for two years; MBA page splits ₹1.50 L tuition + ₹0.10 L registration. Central fee page has an academic-year heading, so obtain itemised offer before payment.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 1.6
fields.Fee Scope: Two-year MBA headline confirmed by official homepage FAQ; tuition plus registration. Hostel, university/other charges and Sunstone/Stride partner variants require quotation.
fields.Accepted Exams: Official direct admissions page: CAT, MAT or GMAT exempts MBA applicants from the institute written test; GD/PI still required. AKTU/UPTAC counselling applies separately.
fields.Selection Process: Direct applicants may take a written test on verbal ability, critical reasoning and general awareness, followed by GD/PI. Valid CAT/MAT/GMAT exempts only the written test. Final merit considers entrance/interview, academics, work experience and suitability.
fields.Avg CTC — Published: No official MBA-only mean located. Secondary MBA course page lists ₹2.5 lakh, with cohort year unspecified.
fields.Placement Scope: No MBA-specific cohort report located. Sunstone pooled mean ₹4.6 lakh is not applied to all MBA students.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Official/credible current listing confirms the management programme.
